title: If you use Seedance 2.0 regularly, choose the Ultra Annual Plan on TopviewAI…
content:
If you use Seedance 2.0 regularly, choose the Ultra Annual Plan on TopviewAI for unlimited Seedance 2.0 Mini generations for a year  
If you need faster Seedance 2.0 results on TopviewAI, switch to Credit Mode (7.8 credits)
